Dear Editor,

We are grateful for the opportunity to revise and resubmit our manuscript,
"*Learning the Shape of Evolutionary Landscapes: Geometric Deep Learning Reveals
Hidden Structure in Phenotype-to-Fitness Maps*." We would also like to thank the
reviewers for their time and effort in providing thoughtful and constructive
feedback.

We have found the reviewers' comments to be extremely valuable and have
addressed them in full. We took every comment very seriously and have worked
diligently to revise the manuscript. We believe the manuscript is substantially
improved as a result. The revisions include clarifications of our methodology,
acknowledgement of the shortcomings of our work, and a more balanced discussion
of our results.

A detailed, point-by-point response to each of the reviewers' comments is
provided below, outlining the changes we have made.

We are confident that the revised manuscript and our accompanying responses have
addressed all the concerns raised. We hope that you and the reviewers will find
our revised work to be a significant contribution and suitable for publication.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,

The authors
